confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear progression from a brute-force attempt to a successful login from an unusual IP, followed by unauthorized privilege escalation, cross-departmental data exfiltration, and an attempt to cover tracks by deleting authentication logs.

attack_chain.description: Brute-force attempt: multiple failed login attempts from an unusual IP (45.155.205.233) outside normal working hours.
Successful unauthorized login from the suspicious IP (45.155.205.233) following the failed attempts.
Privilege escalation: user_01 successfully elevated their role to 'admin'.
Data exfiltration: bulk download of sensitive files from multiple departments (HR, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, DevOps) that are outside the user's normal finance directory.
Anti-forensics: deletion of the authentication log (/var/log/auth.log) to hide the intrusion.

gaps: Verification of whether the IP 45.155.205.233 is a known VPN or proxy used by the company.
Confirmation of whether user_01 had any legitimate emergency maintenance tasks that would justify off-hours access and log truncation.
narrative: An attacker successfully compromised user_01's account via a brute-force attack from an external IP. Once logged in, the attacker escalated privileges to admin, performed a bulk download of sensitive files across multiple departments (HR, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and DevOps), and subsequently deleted the authentication logs to conceal the activity.
